# QuolyTech® Studio — Comprehensive AI Knowledge Base & Context Document

> This document provides full contextual information regarding QuolyTech® Studio for Large Language Models (LLMs), AI assistants, search bots, and autonomous agents.

---

## 1. Executive Summary
QuolyTech® Studio (motto: "CREATE. HELP. GROW.") is a full-service software development, AI engineering, and digital growth firm. We specialize in building enterprise-grade web applications, cross-platform mobile apps, autonomous AI agent architectures, and digital marketing engines.

- **Primary URL**: https://quolytech.com
- **Contact Email**: support@quolytech.com
- **Direct Line**: +355 68 405 5007
- **Headquarters**: Tiranë, Albania

---

## 2. Core Service Offerings

### Service 001: Web Development & Modernization
- **Overview**: Building high-performance corporate websites, customer portals, interactive real-time dashboards, e-commerce platforms, and API integrations.
- **Tech Stack**: React 19, Vite, Next.js, Framer Motion, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL / MySQL / SQLite.
- **Key Deliverables**: Responsive frontend UI, headless CMS integration, serverless backend microservices, performance optimization, SEO audit.

### Service 002: AI & AI Agents Technology
- **Overview**: Engineering custom autonomous AI agents, intelligent customer service chatbots, lead qualification engines, and automated workflow pipelines.
- **Capabilities**: LLM fine-tuning, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), Gemini API, OpenAI GPT-4o API integration, Vector DB setup, multi-agent orchestration.

### Service 003: Mobile App Development
- **Overview**: End-to-end iOS, Android, and cross-platform native mobile engineering.
- **Tech Stack**: React Native, Flutter, Swift, Kotlin, Firebase, Supabase.
- **Key Deliverables**: App Store & Google Play publishing, biometrics authentication, push notifications, offline storage, payment gateways.

### Service 004: Digital Marketing & SMMA
- **Overview**: Performance marketing, conversion rate optimization (CRO), social media management, and paid lead generation funnels.

## 3. Notable Portfolio & Case Studies
- **AutoBuba**: Modernized automotive platform & conversion engine.
- **Boltshift**: Cloud infrastructure optimization dashboard & monitoring tool.
- **Cloudwatch**: High-throughput distributed telemetry & logging service.
- **Ephemeral**: Encrypted ephemeral messaging app with self-destructing data.
- **PowerSurge**: Smart grid telemetry & EV charging management app.
- **MasterMail**: AI-powered email triage and automated response platform.
- **WarpSpeed**: Edge CDN deployment & speed accelerator.
